headline: Discussed a draft letter recommending the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood form-based code to Town Council.
summary: Director of Planning James Rabbitt explained how he drafted the recommendation letter, and members discussed it. Special Legal Counsel Andy Teitz suggested members attend the September 14, 2026 Town Council public hearing in support of the letter. Rabbitt also described upcoming APA and SNEPA events, and members who want to attend can ask him about possible reimbursement.

Town of South Kingstown   
Planning Board   
Work Session Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, August 18, 2026 at 6:30 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, 2nd Floor Conference Room 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Maria H. Mack, Chair 
Susan Axelrod, Vice Chair 
Elizabeth Karp, Secretary 
Paul Jordan 
Armand Monaco 
Robyn Pothier 
Kaiper Wilson 
 
A. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
Ms. Mack called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. 
 
ROLL CALL: 
Present: Susan Axelrod, Liz Karp, Armand Monaco, Robyn Pothier, Kaiper Wilson, and Maria Mack. 
Absent:  Paul Jordan 
 
Also present: James Rabbitt, Director of Planning; Brian Wagner, Deputy Director of Planning; Curtis Dufour, Principal 
Planner; and Andy Teitz, Special Legal Counsel (Mr. Teitz arrived at 6:42 p.m.). 
B. Recommendations to Town Council: 
 1. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code: Review and Recommendation to the South 
Kingstown Town Council. 
Ms. Mack referenced the draft Town Council recommendation letter sent out to the Planning Board members by Mr. 
Rabbitt.  Mr. Rabbitt reviewed the process he used for creating the draft letter, for the PB review.   
 
Discussion of the draft Letter of Recommendation ensued. 
 
Mr. Teitz suggested the Planning Board members attend the September 14, 2026, Town Council Public Hearing in 
support of their Letter of Recommendation of the Form-Based Code. 
C. Reports and Special Items: 
Mr. Rabbitt briefly discussed the APA Annual event and the Southern New England American Planning Association 
(SNEPA) event coming up; any member interested in attending should let him know for possible full or partial 
reimbursement. 
D. Report of Administrative Officer: 
None. 
E. Adjournment: 
Upon motion made by Ms. Wilson, duly seconded by Mr. Monaco, the meeting was adjourned at 7:30 p.m., by 
unanimous vote.
